title: Adult clinical seizure-event detection
disposition_reason: A within-Siena event evaluator, causal line-length and timing references are delivered as construction source. Selected complete-patient support is checked, but source authentication and full-cohort qualification are not established; CHB-to-Siena transfer belongs to NEURAL-012.

scientific_target.question: Can a causal EEG detector identify annotated ictal events across complete held Siena patient recordings at an acceptable observed-time false-alarm burden?
scientific_target.known_answer: Siena recording-relative seizure intervals after explicit reconciliation of source clock annotations and native EDF start clocks.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Siena 1.0.0 seizure-list files, EDF headers and patient metadata. Clock mismatches require adjudication, not silently choosing whichever origin improves scores.
scientific_target.case_unit: A complete selected Siena recording with scores on its frozen output grid.
scientific_target.independent_unit: PN patient identity; 41 source recordings belong to 14 people, with all files from a patient grouped.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Within-Siena public-development monitoring; event scoring is a tolerant retrospective metric even if predictor context is declared causal.
exclusions: CHB-trained cross-cohort robustness from within-Siena evaluation
Clinical onset timing inferred from tolerant event coverage

inputs: Causally computed selected genuine EEG channels in microvolts; the representative acquisition is 512 Hz with heterogeneous EEG and auxiliary channel names.
Frozen ordered EEG channel map, recording duration and elapsed time needed for the separate timing comparator.
forbidden_inputs: EKG, SPO2, HR, marker/annotation and other auxiliary channels in neural-only arms
Held-patient labels, seizure-list clocks or future EEG
Target-dependent crop selection or threshold tuning
observation_contract.case_identity: The source inventory enumerates 41 recordings/14 PN identities; the evaluator consumes operator manifests for complete selected-patient recordings and rejects patient overlap and missing vectors.
observation_contract.split: Within-Siena train/evaluation patient sets are disjoint. The current package does not automatically execute a complete 14-fold outer study; a frozen full-cohort run protocol must ensure every patient is evaluated.
observation_contract.coverage: All selected patient recordings including nonseizure time are mandatory; selected-set completeness is not a claim that all 14 patients have been executed.

primary.name: patient_macro_event_f1
primary.aggregation: Current score_manifest uses _mean_defined: equal mean over only patients whose metric is nonnull, with defined/undefined ID lists. This differs from an all-selected-person denominator. Full14 inference requires the operator to verify complete annotation support and defined endpoints for all14; otherwise report the selected defined-only result and mark the full-cohort comparison incomplete.
primary.rationale: Requires event coverage across complete monitoring while compulsory false-alarm and sensitivity metrics expose threshold tradeoffs.

secondary: Patient-macro event sensitivity and false alarms per 24 observed hours
Per-patient event counts, observed duration and paired difference from fixed line-length/timing references
Clock-profile sensitivity for unresolved source/header origins before one source interpretation is selected
Mandatory f1_defined_patients, f1_undefined_patients, sensitivity_undefined_patients and paired-bootstrap excluded identities alongside every denominator.
Proposed predicted-positive time fraction companion to expose long-tolerance constant/extended-event credit; current source does not emit this occupancy metric.

comparators.name: Causal line-length v1
comparators.inputs: Training-only EEG and seizure annotations; test EEG without labels
comparators.procedure: Implemented feature/threshold fit and predict source; competence awaits authentic complete patient evaluation.

comparators.name: Timing-only v1
comparators.inputs: Elapsed monitoring time and training annotations, no EEG
comparators.procedure: Implemented training-only nuisance comparator under the same patient split.

comparators.name: Constant detector
comparators.procedure: Proposed degenerate detector control on complete support. Current scorer reports constant_scores and event metrics; predicted-positive occupancy is a required companion diagnostic still to implement, not a delivered output.

nuisance_controls: Exclude all non-EEG channel roles using original header provenance.
Preserve entire observed background and record boundaries.
Resolve midnight wrapping and inconsistent clock origins explicitly; do not score unreviewed ambiguous annotations as certain.
Fit normalization and thresholds exclusively on training patients.
evaluation.uncertainty: Current paired_bootstrap includes only people with defined F1 in both arms and explicitly reports excluded IDs; fewer than two supported people yields insufficient_independent_patients. This is descriptive selected-support uncertainty. Full14 inference additionally requires independently verified complete annotations and defined paired endpoints for all14; current code does not enforce that complete-cohort criterion. Shared training and clinical selection further limit generalization.
evaluation.failure_policy: Reject patient overlap, missing recordings, nonfinite/incomplete scores and prohibited channels. Clock/source ambiguity blocks the affected scientific evaluation rather than silently dropping the file.

implementation.scorer_target: Computes event metrics from private normalized annotations and candidate score arrays. _mean_defined averages only nonnull patient metrics, reports support, and paired_bootstrap drops people with undefined F1 in either arm while listing exclusions. It checks complete selected recording vectors, not annotation completeness or an all14-person scientific denominator.
implementation.delivered_scope: Generated engineering controls plus small source-metadata inspection; no authentic EEG/header equality or detector performance claim.
missing: Authenticate EDF calibration/channel roles and adjudicate clock ambiguities.
Freeze complete patient folds and execute competent signal/timing references.
Provision protected participant execution and verify actual training provenance.
Independently verify complete annotations and defined paired endpoints for all14 before a full-cohort claim; expose current defined-only aggregation and bootstrap exclusions.
Implement predicted-positive occupancy and constant-detector comparisons as named prospective controls; current score_manifest emits event metrics, duration and constant_scores without occupancy.
implementation.execution_evidence: Package documentation records generated engineering checks and small metadata inspection; no new scientific execution.

direct_observation.representation: Complete continuous EEG could be interpreted directly with calibrated displays, but no no-tools full-record protocol is delivered.
direct_observation.boundary: Only the declared observation/demonstration context, no external tools or evaluator feedback; a new direct condition needs an independently frozen view and complete output identity.
missing: No delivered participant condition establishes this mode for the same scientific target.

typed_viewer.representation: Typed multichannel viewing would be suitable for interval annotation; no Siena image transport is delivered.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only typed render/navigation actions with audited limits; no raw arrays, labels, filenames or external source retrieval returned to the participant.
missing: No delivered participant condition establishes this mode for the same scientific target.

tool_assisted.representation: The evaluator and fit/predict commands are analysis tools; an interactive case-level investigator protocol and target-withholding broker are not delivered.
tool_assisted.boundary: Same permitted observations, frozen checkpoint tools and accounted compute as the compared arm; case state and feedback policy must be fixed before query.
missing: No delivered participant condition establishes this mode for the same scientific target.

frozen_program.representation: reference.py supplies preselected fit/predict implementations for line-length and timing arms; a protected arbitrary-candidate runner and authentic source packet are absent.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze code and fitting/adaptation recipe before queries; admit only explicitly allowed labels/calibration, retain all failed/incomplete cases.
missing: The inspected source supports reconstruction or fixed-reference computation; a participant condition for the revised withheld scientific target is not delivered.

evidence.supports: Computes actual patient event metrics from private normalized annotations and candidate score arrays, and optionally paired comparison uncertainty; source clock parsing and causal reference code are present.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: No model or human outcome is established by these source artifacts. The repository historical four neural programme attempts concern NEURAL-007/077, not this task; no new direct/viewer evidence is claimed.

summary: Separate implemented within-cohort evaluator from unimplemented full-cohort execution and cross-cohort transfer.
Treat native clock/channel reconciliation as scientific eligibility, retaining the false-alarm denominator.
Disclose current defined-only patient aggregation and pairwise exclusions; full14 scientific support is an additional unmet qualification condition, not an enforced source property.
revision.source_review: Inspected original task/source metadata, assigned implementation and target-relevant code. Reused preserved primary-source audits; dataset/official-source landing pages checked on2026-11-16. No neural payload, private labels or candidate output accessed.
